verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; Google spend is not converting efficiently.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 27 leads at an average cost per lead of $146.16 — all 27 came through Meta, which delivered them at roughly $47 each. Google Ads spent $2,668 in the same window and produced only 5 conversions, pushing your blended cost per lead up 115% week over week. We are auditing the Google Search campaign's bid strategy and targeting to address this directly. The Google Business Profile also showed no recorded actions for three consecutive days this week, which we are monitoring for a profile or data issue. Next week you should see initial changes to the Google campaign take effect, and we expect the Business Profile activity to normalize as that is resolved.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all sourced through Meta
blended cost per lead this period, up from roughly $68 the prior week
spent on Google Ads this period, yielding only 5 conversions

watch_item.issue: Google Ads is spending at full pace but converting at a fraction of Meta's efficiency — $533 per conversion versus Meta's $47.
watch_item.fix: The Search campaign is under active review this week for bid strategy and targeting adjustments to bring cost per conversion in line.
